Class SmartMotorControllerConfig<T extends SmartMotorControllerConfig<T>>

java.lang.Object
yams.core.motorcontrollers.SmartMotorControllerConfig<T>
Direct Known Subclasses:
SmartMotorControllerConfig, SmartMotorControllerConfig
public abstract class SmartMotorControllerConfig<T extends SmartMotorControllerConfig<T>> extends Object
Smart motor controller config.

Example

SmartMotorControllerConfig config = new SmartMotorControllerConfig()
    .withMotorInverted(false)
    .withStatorCurrentLimit(Amps.of(40))
    .withSupplyCurrentLimit(Amps.of(60))
    .withFeedforward(new SimpleMotorFeedforward(0.001, 0.002))
    .withMechanismUpperLimit(Degrees.of(90))
    .withMechanismLowerLimit(Degrees.of(-90))
    .withGearing(new GearBox(12.0, 60.0));

    • withVendorConfig

      public T withVendorConfig(Object vendorConfig)
      Set the vendor specific config for the SmartMotorController which will be used as a base. Vendor configs will be overridden by the SmartMotorControllerConfig options.
      Parameters:
      vendorConfig - Vendor specific config object. Must be of the correct type for the SmartMotorController. Only the root configuration class is accepted.
      Returns:
      SmartMotorControllerConfig for chaining.
      Implementation Requirements:
      SmartMotorControllerConfig options will always take precedence and overwrite the vendor config. Apply any changes after the SmartMotorController is created to ensure accuracy.

    • withExternalEncoder

      public T withExternalEncoder(Object externalEncoder)
      Set the external encoder which is attached to the motor type sent used by SmartMotorController

      Supported external encoders:

      • SPARK MAX and SPARK Flex: the SPARK's absolute encoder, the SPARK MAX's alternate encoder or the SPARK Flex's external encoder (quadrature, whose counts per revolution come from the vendor config), or an encoder the SPARK reads over CAN (a REVLib DetachedEncoder).
      • TalonFX and TalonFXS: a CANcoder, or a CANdi whose PWM input is selected by the feedback sensor source of the vendor config.
      Parameters:
      externalEncoder - External encoder attached to the SmartMotorController
      Returns:
      SmartMotorControllerConfig for chaining.

    • convertToVoltage

      public org.wpilib.units.measure.Voltage convertToVoltage(org.wpilib.math.system.DCMotor motor, org.wpilib.units.measure.Force feedforwardForce)
      Convert a feedforward Force applied at the mechanism into the equivalent motor feedforward Voltage, using gearing and mechanismCircumference. This is only the voltage that produces the force (the resistive drop of the matching current), not the back-EMF of the commanded speed, since it is added on top of a velocity feedforward that already covers that.
      Parameters:
      motor - DCMotor of the mechanism.
      feedforwardForce - Feedforward Force applied to the mechanism.
      Returns:
      Equivalent feedforward Voltage at the motor.
      Throws:
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the mechanism circumference is not configured.

    • convertToCurrent

      public org.wpilib.units.measure.Current convertToCurrent(org.wpilib.math.system.DCMotor motor, org.wpilib.units.measure.Force feedforwardForce)
      Convert a feedforward Force applied at the mechanism into the equivalent motor feedforward Current, using gearing and mechanismCircumference. This is the feedforward to use for torque-current based closed-loop control (e.g. TorqueCurrentFOC).
      Parameters:
      motor - DCMotor of the mechanism.
      feedforwardForce - Feedforward Force applied to the mechanism.
      Returns:
      Equivalent feedforward Current at the motor.
      Throws:
      SmartMotorControllerConfigurationException - if the mechanism circumference is not configured.
